2026_04_TEN_BAL.headline: Baltimore reshuffles its front as Cam Ward tries to punish the Ravens’ injuries
2026_04_TEN_BAL.paragraph1: Baltimore enters Sunday with unusual strain in the trenches: Trey Hendrickson is out and rookie Vega Ioane is moving to center after injuries thinned the position. That puts more responsibility on Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry to keep the Ravens out of obvious passing situations. Tennessee arrives winless but can attack the disruption with Cam Ward and a defense led by rookie Anthony Hill Jr.; Robert Saleh’s group needs early-down stops and pressure to prevent Baltimore’s playmakers from controlling tempo.
2026_04_TEN_BAL.model_rationale: Baltimore retains more offensive answers, but its reshuffled line and missing edge presence give Tennessee a clearer path if Ward protects the ball and the Titans win early downs.
